create_smolvlm_image_processor: create a SmolVLMImageProcessorPil instance with custom max_image_size and do_image_splitting settings
run_preprocess_images: run the preprocess method on a list of PIL images to produce pixel_values and pixel_attention_mask tensors
resize_image_to_max_side: resize an image to a specified longest edge while preserving aspect ratio and respecting MAX_IMAGE_SIZE
split_image_into_patches: split a large image into sub-image patches based on max_image_size longest_edge dimensions
pad_image_with_attention_mask: pad an image to a target size and generate a pixel attention mask indicating valid regions
